hypothesis: A frozen forecast can veto packing that looks safe now but predicts a destination crossing 80% five minutes later, potentially avoiding a later move.
control: readonly_demand_matrix; same source eligibility, physical resources, current incoming VM demand, power ranking and robust predictor.
rule: For LR only use max(current target demand, already-issued target forecast plus demand of other proposed incoming VMs), then add candidate current demand. No new fit or learner update; unavailable/stale/changed-group forecasts fall back to current demand.
restrictions: no new model tuning or data
no forecasting candidate VM future demand
no change to overload placement path
THR and IQR must remain byte-identical to demand control
success_criteria: compare energy,migrations,sampled CPU shortfall; no automatic winner claim
